THE PREDICTION

  CHANGES
    service_lines appears with three rows; physical is NOT confidential.
    kw_line_is_confidential() appears, fail-closed: an unrecognised line is
    treated as confidential.
    Five check constraints admit 'physical'.
    All 9 bookings policies stop naming a line literally -> 0.
    The report gains BOTH filters: non-confidential AND delivered-only.

  DOES NOT CHANGE
    France still sees 22. Lone still sees 22. Karabo still sees 0. HR still
    sees 0. No row's service_line is altered: every existing row is
    'financial', which is non-confidential — exactly what the old literal said.
    No booking, member, contract or activity added or removed.

  IF IT IS WRONG
    A line classified wrongly in service_lines — one UPDATE to fix. The
    dangerous direction is guarded: the migration refuses to finish if
    'psychosocial' is not confidential or if 'financial' is.

  EXPECTED AFTER-STATE, EXACTLY
    France 22, Lone 22, Karabo 0, HR 0 — all unchanged.
    service_lines present with 3 rows, kw_line_is_confidential present.
    checks admit physical. policies naming a line literally: 0.
    both report filters: yes.
